summary: English and Indonesian first-party discovery identified BAGOS as Banyuwangi's official municipal WebGIS and ATR/BPN BHUMI/ATLAS as the national cadastral lead. BAGOS WMS/WFS capabilities were reachable and inspected, but no cadastral parcel layer was evidenced. A bounded PBB thematic polygon response was observed but rejected as non-cadastral; the exact-point bbox returned zero features. No GeoJSON sample is retained.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: All discovery queries, URLs, routes, response statuses, JavaScript/configuration findings, schema/CRS observations, and scope limits are recorded in city-7996-banyuwangi.json. Scratch responses are under tmp/valhalla-parcel-research/banyuwangi/.

custodians.name: Pemerintah Kabupaten Banyuwangi
custodians.scope: Local municipal geospatial portal, thematic layer catalog, and BAGOS WMS/WFS

custodians.name: Kementerian Agraria dan Tata Ruang / Badan Pertanahan Nasional (ATR/BPN)
custodians.scope: National cadastral and land-information viewer/catalog lead

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only if source-proven
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [-8.21557023643141, 114.365161016598] was preserved in latitude/longitude order and not shifted.
The exact-point WFS bbox miss was for one tested PBB thematic layer only and is not citywide cadastral absence evidence.
No cadastral parcel ID-plus-geometry response was qualified, so no sample polygon is retained.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account, rights-holder, mutation, sale, or litigation fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion is not source integration/admission.
uncertainty: No cadastral parcel layer exposed by the inspected local capabilities
National BHUMI/ATLAS parcel route not resolved to an anonymous Banyuwangi feature response
Independent serial review required before adapter/runtime qualification
doNotInfer: A thematic PBB map miss is not citywide cadastral absence
A public WFS capability response is not proof of cadastral parcel coverage
A PBB polygon feature id is not automatically a native parcel identity
Packet completion is not source integration or runtime admission
